description:
Kangjoo's life suddenly became a mess after she found out about her fiance's affair. Now the dream house she built for their marriage is the only thing she has. However, her life is slowly getting better after her new housemate, Jisoo, came. She's finally opening up once more for a new love.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/pf_dinner), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/home/52662892), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3943456), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/perfect_dinner)

**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian](https://id.kakaowebtoon.com/content/Housemate-Ku-Cintaku/505), [French](https://www.delitoon.com/detail/daf_1000657), [German](https://www.delitoon.de/detail/dad_2000192)
